description: Every v4 release-rule form (fixed dates including impossible ones, +N/-N, +weekday/-weekday, sentinels, duplicates) and every step of the rule precedence, each set up so a more specific target decides the opposite of a less specific one. Outcomes are fixed until January 2046 (2018, 2099, or +9999 days). A 5-digit day count is ignored, as v4 does. exam 3 is not on the calendar.
